user.title: Select Language
user.description: Please select your preferred language. This will determine the Bergfex domain used.

type.title: Select Report Type
type.description: Please select the type of report you want to monitor.

country.title: Select Country
country.description: Please select the country the area is located in.

ski_area_list.title: Select Bergfex Area
ski_area_list.description: Please select the {report_type} you want to monitor in {country}. Alternatively, you can enter the URL path for an area not found in the list.

ski_area_list_alpine.title: Select Bergfex Ski Resort
ski_area_list_alpine.description: Please select the ski resort you want to monitor in {country} ([Link to overview]({url})). Alternatively, you can enter the URL path for a resort not found in the list.

ski_area_list_cross_country.title: Select Bergfex Cross Country Area
ski_area_list_cross_country.description: Please select the cross country ski area you want to monitor in {country} ([Link to overview]({url})). Alternatively, you can enter the URL path for an area not found in the list.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Bergfex. Please check your internet connection.
error.no_areas_found: Could not find any ski areas for the selected country. There might be no current snow reports available.
error.no_selection: Please select a ski area from the list or provide a manual path.
error.invalid_path: That address does not name a ski area. Enter a resort path such as "/ischgl/schneebericht/", or paste the full URL of the resort's page.
error.invalid_webhook: That is not a valid webhook address. Use a full http:// or https:// URL, or leave the field empty.

abort.already_configured: This ski area is already configured.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Update interval in minutes. Bergfex may block IP addresses that poll too often. The language also selects which Bergfex domain is used; changing it reloads the integration.

standalone_card_installed.title: Remove the standalone Bergfex Card
standalone_card_installed.description: The Bergfex card now ships with this integration. The separate "Bergfex Card" is still installed via HACS and loads a second, conflicting copy. Open HACS, uninstall "Bergfex Card", then restart Home Assistant.

duplicate_resort_entry.title: Bergfex resort configured twice
duplicate_resort_entry.description: The resort "{resort}" ({path}) is set up more than once. Both entries produce the same entities, so only one of them can work and the other one stays broken. This repair is about the entry with the ID {entry_id} - the one that cannot work. Select "Fix" below to delete exactly that entry; the other one keeps working.

confirm.title: Delete the duplicate entry
confirm.description: Delete the duplicate Bergfex entry for "{resort}" ({path})? Only the entry with the ID {entry_id} is removed. The other entry for this resort keeps its devices and entities and takes the resort over right away.
